title: What's New: Setting Up Copilot in Business Central - Tips for Admins (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Copilot ready out of the box
Data governance and Azure OpenAI regions

features.name: Copilot for Business Central
features.description: AI-powered assistant included with Business Central online licenses at no additional cost that helps users improve productivity, boost creativity, and eliminate tedious tasks like bank reconciliation and getting data insights.
caveats: Feature availability varies by language and geography
Some languages are unsupported and may not perform as expected

features.name: Copilot and AI capabilities page
features.description: An admin page that provides transparency and control over all Copilot features and capabilities, allowing admins to see which features are generally available or in preview, view publishers, and activate or deactivate features per environment.
caveats: Settings are per environment affecting all users and companies
Extensions from third-party publishers may add capabilities

features.name: Production ready preview features
features.description: Copilot features marked as preview are labeled as production ready previews and are safe to use in production with users across the organization.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have some generally available features but then also some features in preview as well and these are clearly labeled as production ready previews
caveats: Features are labeled to distinguish preview from GA

features.name: Feature deactivation capability
features.description: Admins can deactivate individual Copilot features per environment with a reason, making them instantly inactive and inaccessible to users.
caveats: Changes affect all users in all companies within that environment

features.name: Copilot language support
features.description: Copilot features are available in all Business Central languages, but only a subset are rigorously verified and tested by Microsoft as supported languages. Unsupported languages may not perform as expected.
caveats: Each feature defines its own set of supported languages
Unsupported languages may not perform as expected and quality may vary

features.name: Geographic availability of Copilot features
features.description: Copilot capabilities are available in all countries and geographies with a few exceptions. Features that are not available for certain environment country localizations will not appear in the Copilot and AI capabilities list.
caveats: Some features are not available in certain country localizations
Features unavailable in a region will not appear in the list

features.name: Azure OpenAI Service integration
features.description: Copilot is powered by the Azure OpenAI Service which is part of the Azure cloud and designed for enterprise use with security, privacy, and compliance features.
caveats: Azure OpenAI Service is not available in all regions for Business Central

features.name: Data movement control
features.description: In regions without local Azure OpenAI Service, admins have a switch to control whether data can move to a different region where the service is available. Only minimal prompt and response data is moved, not the entire database.
caveats: Only available as an option in regions without local Azure OpenAI Service
Data moves to regions like Sweden or Switzerland in certain cases

features.name: Copilot security and user context
features.description: Copilot runs under the user's same security context, meaning all data governance controls for security and privacy apply to Copilot as well.

features.name: Copilot feature permissions
features.description: Admins can control which Copilot features users can access through specific permissions that can be applied or denied for each feature, allowing fine-grain control down to the individual feature level.
caveats: Not every feature has individual permissions available

features.name: Data privacy - no AI model training
features.description: Microsoft does not use Copilot data to train AI models for the benefit of others and does not examine user prompts without explicit consent.
